_README: These deliberately have no detail page of their own - each card links to
booking.html?activity=<slug>, and js/inquiry.js preselects it in the form.
Edit here, then run:  python3 scripts/build_listings.py

activities.name: Hussaini Suspension Bridge
activities.summary: Cross one of the most photographed rope bridges in the world, over the Hunza river at Hussaini. Widely spaced planks, a long span, and a lot of wind.

activities.name: Attabad Lake Boating
activities.summary: A boat out onto the turquoise lake formed by the 2010 landslide, with the drowned section of the old Karakoram Highway still visible below the surface.

activities.name: Skiing at Naltar
activities.summary: Lift-served skiing at the Air Force resort above Naltar - the most accessible skiing in Pakistan. Beginners upward; hire and instruction arranged locally.

activities.name: Hopper Glacier Walk
activities.summary: Stand on a glacier twenty minutes from the road. The Hopper (Bualtar) glacier is black with moraine and genuinely enormous.

activities.name: Blossom Season Walks
activities.summary: Guided walks through the apricot and cherry orchards in late March and April, when the whole valley floor turns white and pink. Seasonal.

activities.name: Trout Fishing at Phander
activities.summary: The Ghizer river and Phander Lake hold good brown trout. Permits, rods and a local guide who knows where the fish actually are.
